question: Where’s the closest fast food restaurant along the travel direction toward Rose Art Museum, Waltham, MA?
sql: WITH museum_location AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Rose Art Museum%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Waltham%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%MA%' LIMIT 1 ), waltham_region AS ( SELECT geometry FROM regions WHERE region_name ILIKE '%Waltham%' AND border_type = 'city' LIMIT 1 ), origin_and_bearing AS ( SELECT ST_Centroid(waltham_region.geometry) AS origin_point, degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_Centroid(waltham_region.geometry), museum_location.geometry)) AS target_bearing FROM waltham_region, museum_location ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_state, p.addr_city FROM pois AS p, origin_and_bearing AS oab WHERE p.amenity = 'fast_food' -- Filter fast food restaurants within a reasonable distance from the hypothetical origin (Waltham city center) AND ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, oab.origin_point::geography, 15000) -- Search within 15km radius AND ( -- Calculate the bearing from the hypothetical origin to the fast food restaurant -- and check if it's within +/- 45 degrees of the bearing from origin to museum. -- LEAST handles angle wrap-around (e.g., 350 degrees vs 10 degrees) LEAST( ABS(degrees(ST_Azimuth(oab.origin_point, p.geometry)) - oab.target_bearing), 360 - ABS(degrees(ST_Azimuth(oab.origin_point, p.geometry)) - oab.target_bearing) ) < 45 ) ORDER BY -- Order by distance from the hypothetical origin to find the "closest along the travel direction" ST_Distance(oab.origin_point::geography, p.geometry::geography) ASC LIMIT 1;
